title: Easy Poke Cake
description: This easy poke cake recipe makes a moist, flavorful, and very tasty dessert with cake mix, pudding, and your favorite fruit flavored Jell-O.
ingredients: 1 (3.5 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (3 ounce) package fruit flavored Jell-O® mix
1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9x13-inch baking pan.
Combine cake mix, pudding mix, eggs, 1 cup water and the vegetable oil and blend well. Beat at the medium speed of an electric mixer for 4 minutes. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 45 to 50 minutes or until the cake springs back when lightly touched. Let cake cool in pan for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, dissolve the gelatin in the boiling water, then add the cold water.
Poke holes in the warm cake with a fork at 1/2 inch intervals. Pour gelatin over cake. Chill cake completely before frosting with whipped topping. Keep cake refrigerated.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make poke cake with a fruit flavored jello mix. This recipe’s cake mixture is made with white cake mix, instant vanilla pudding mix, eggs, water, and vegetable oil. After baking the cake, poke holes throughout it and pour the jello mixture in. Finally, chill the cake for at least four hours before adding the icing. This delicious cake is moist, flavorful, and easy to make.
